story_zh: 在北京的胡同里，隔壁的姑姑是当地人。她穿着丝绸服装，在阳台晒小麦。姑娘很乖，帮忙干活儿。舅舅从农村来，带来桔子和馒头。我们吃点心，口味有辣。华裔朋友说：“这地区方言真有趣！”
story_pinyin: Zài Běijīng de hútòng lǐ, gébì de gūgu shì dāngdì rén. Tā chuānzhe sīchóu fúzhuāng, zài yángtái shài xiǎomài. Gūniang hěn guāi, bāngmáng gànhuór. Jiùjiu cóng nóngcūn lái, dài lái júzi hé mántou. Wǒmen chī diǎnxīn, kǒuwèi yǒu là. Huáyì péngyou shuō: “Zhè dìqū fāngyán zhēn yǒuqù!”
story_en: In a Beijing alley, the aunt next door is a local. She wears silk clothing and dries wheat on the balcony. The girl is well-behaved and helps with work. Uncle comes from the countryside, bringing tangerines and steamed buns. We eat dim sum, which has a spicy flavor. An ethnic Chinese friend says: "The dialect in this region is really interesting!"
